description_en: Creates a ConfigMap instance in a namespace
description_zh: 创建命名空间中的ConfigMap实例
kebab_example: aliyun sae create-config-map --name name --namespace-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConfigMap

parameters.help_en: The name of the ConfigMap instance. The name can contain digits, letters, and underscores (_), and must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh: ConfigMap实例名称。允许数字、字母和下划线（_）组合，仅允许以字母开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace where the ConfigMap instance resides
parameters.name: namespace_id
data

parameters.help_en: The description. The description cannot contain spaces and can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息，不可输入空格，且不超过255个字符
parameters.name: description

Code.description_en:
The API status code or POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: Success.
3xx: Redirection.
4xx: Request error.
5xx: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ConfigMapId.description_en: The instance ID of the created ConfigMap

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

Successful request: The ErrorCode parameter is not returned.
Failed request: The ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en: The additional information about the call result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the ConfigMap instance was created successfully. Valid values:

true: Created.
false: Failed to create
Success.description_zh:
创建ConfigMap实例是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：创建成功。
false：创建失败

TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
